select: highest dev greedy top-1 macro (exact reference agreement, NFC), then lower dev mean CER, then earlier update
input: lower-cased English word as UTF-8 bytes + EOS (unchanged from E06); no pronunciation, no prefix
fixes: max_new_tokens 121 with a no_eos status (latent E06 defect)
LoRA wrapper exposes the frozen base weight so FFN layers can be adapted
metrics: top-4 oracle at equal beam-4 budget
distinct top-1 and most frequent share
rationale: From the audit and the passed tiny gate: the pipeline can learn input-dependent outputs, so E06's collapse is an adaptation limitation. Kept from the tiny diagnostic: FFN + attention adapters (capacity; PEFT notes all-linear targeting can approach full fine-tuning) and lr 1e-3. Changed from E06: FFN targets, 3x the updates and 2x the batch (about 43 epochs vs 7) so cross-attention has time to learn the mapping before the schedule decays. Kept from E06 for generalisation on 2,255 noisy mined pairs: base dropout 0.1 and adapter dropout 0.05 (zero dropout was only for memorisation). Linear decay to 0 after a 100-update warm-up.
